title: Visualising the Four Ps in Motion

scenes.title: Nimbus One And The Four Ps

visual_beats.directive: Headphones appear at the centre
Four Ps orbit into place
Plan numbers slide beside the product

narration.text: Meet Auralis Audio, a premium headphone maker launching the Nimbus One. Four tiles orbit it: Product, Price, Place and Promotion. Marketing mix means all the activities which go into marketing a product or service, often summarised as the four Ps. The plan is twenty thousand units at a one hundred and twenty dollar price, sold online and in shops. Every tile must support the others. Follow the life cycle, pricing, distribution and two kinds of promotion in one journey.

visual_beats.directive: Package wrap closes around the product
Box opens to reveal matte finish
Brand badge and quality tag appear

narration.text: Product comes first. Brand image is an image or identity given to a product which distinguishes it from competitors brands. Packaging is the physical container or wrapping to protect a product and help in promoting it. The case opens to reveal a matte finish and a brand badge, signalling quality on the shelf. New products can win fresh customers, yet they consume cash and can fail in a crowded market. Good design must serve the chosen buyer.

visual_beats.directive: Axes and curve outline draw in
Stage markers appear at four points
Curve flattens then falls to decline

narration.text: The product life cycle shows the stages a product passes through: introduction, growth, maturity and decline. A curve draws in. Sales climb from two thousand units in introduction, to nine thousand in growth, to fourteen thousand at maturity, then ease to six thousand in decline. The line rises, flattens, then falls. Each stage needs a different mix: launch spending early, differentiation at maturity, cost control late. Reading the curve tells managers when to act.

visual_beats.directive: Four action tiles drop in sequence
Gift pack and sports version appear
Curve bends upward a second time

narration.text: At maturity, extension strategies can lift the curve. Four tiles appear: new markets, new uses, adapting the product or packaging, and increased advertising plus sales promotion. Auralis Audio tries a sports version and a gift pack, and the curve bends upward twice. New markets bring buyers but need research. New uses widen appeal but may confuse the brand. Adapting packaging is cheap but short lived. Choose the extension that fits the segment.

scenes.title: Four Pricing Methods In Motion
labels: Cost plus: cost plus mark up

visual_beats.directive: Cost plus and competitive tags settle
Dynamic tag flickers with demand meter
Loss leader tag dips and store traffic rises

narration.text: Cost plus pricing is the cost of manufacturing the product plus a profit mark up. Competitive pricing sets the product in line with rivals to protect market share. Dynamic pricing changes the price online as demand shifts; the tag flickers with a demand meter. A loss leader sells one item cheaply to draw shoppers into the range. Revenue direction lines rise or dip with each method, and no formula is needed here.

visual_beats.directive: Low price curve climbs steeply
High price curve starts high then eases
Premium badge locks onto the skimming path

narration.text: Two launch prices. Penetration pricing sets a price below rivals to enter a market and gain market share; the low line climbs as buyers join. Price skimming sets a high price for a new product; the high line starts high and eases as buyers are served. When price is lower, more buyers may respond, so revenue can grow. Because the Nimbus One is premium, therefore skimming recovers costs first, so promotion can follow.

scenes.title: Distribution Routes And Ecommerce
labels: Producer to wholesaler to retailer to buyer
Direct keeps control, indirect widens reach
Ecommerce adds delivery and returns costs

visual_beats.directive: Product dots move along the direct line
Dots pass through wholesaler and retailer
Online store icon opens with cost tags

narration.text: Place is the means by which a product is passed from the producer to the customer. Direct sales run from Auralis Audio straight to buyers online. Indirect routes pass through a wholesaler, then a retailer, then the customer, with an agent. Product dots travel both paths. Ecommerce is the online buying and selling of goods and services using internet linked devices. It widens reach but adds delivery, returns and security costs. Direct keeps control; indirect widens coverage.

visual_beats.directive: Specification sheet fills with features
Lifestyle frame replaces it
Voucher and reward tiles pop up

narration.text: Promotion has two parts. Advertising is a paid for communication with potential customers about a product to encourage them to buy it. Informative advertising explains features; persuasive advertising builds feeling and status. Social media, emails, leaflets and billboards show both. Sales promotions are incentives such as special offers, discounts, or reward schemes aimed at consumers to achieve short term increases in sales; vouchers join them. Information builds understanding, persuasion lifts desire, offers trigger action.

scenes.title: Does The Whole Mix Fit
labels: Premium set: margin and clear image

visual_beats.directive: Four Ps snap into a single frame
Benefits and limits columns appear
Verdict banner confirms premium choice

narration.text: Now judge the whole mix. A premium product with skimming, selective retail and informative promotion supports a high price. The benefit is margin and image; the limit is lower volume and higher selling costs. A penetration price may grow share but weaken the premium story. Because the four Ps must fit together, therefore Auralis Audio keeps the premium set, so every tile reinforces one message. A coherent mix beats a mismatch.

recap_quiz.question: Auralis Audio launches a premium headphone with unique sensors and wants to recover development costs before rivals enter. Which price fits best?
recap_quiz.visual_explanation: A high starting price curve eases downward while a low penetration curve climbs, and a premium badge locks onto the high path.
